name: partially_succeed_policy_classifies_before_routing
workflow:
digraph T {
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  a [prompt="x", on_failure="partially_succeed"]
  recover [prompt="x"]
  b [prompt="x"]
  start -> a
  a -> recover [condition="outcome=failed"]
  a -> b
  recover -> exit
  b -> exit

}
departure: deliberate departure: Fabro takes the explicit outcome=failed edge and only promotes an unmatched failure; Petri classifies once at the step boundary, so the failure is a partial success before routing and `b` is taken
